benefits.study: According to "Anti-cancer agents in medicinal chemistry", Centella asiatica, specifically Asiatic Acid (AA), exerts anti-cancer effects through various pathways, including oxidative/antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, cytotoxicity, apoptotic cell death, and inhibition of cell proliferation and migration.

intro: Centella asiatica, commonly known as gotu kola, is a powerful herb that offers a wide range of health benefits. It is well-known for its ability to enhance cognitive function, improve memory, and reduce mental fatigue, making it ideal for students and professionals seeking mental clarity. The plant also promotes skin health by stimulating collagen production, aiding in the treatment of wounds, scars, and varicose veins, which can enhance overall appearance and confidence. Additionally, Centella asiatica supports circulation, reduces inflammation, and may even help in managing conditions like diabetes and hypertension, contributing to a healthier, more active lifestyle.
